summary: Responsive-layout verification of SmartDry Connect at 3 viewports (1920x900 desktop, 834x1112 tablet PRIORITY, 390x844 mobile) across all 8 authenticated routes (/, /monitor, /new-batch, /history, /energy, /traceability, /status, /batches/:id) and the public /trace/:id passport. All 27 (viewport x route) combinations show scrollWidth == clientWidth (zero horizontal page overflow) and non-empty main content. Mobile hamburger menu opens revealing all 7 nav links + Sign out. Batch History table correctly scrolls inside its own overflow-x-auto container on mobile (inner scrollWidth=1045px, clientWidth=356px) while the page itself does not scroll sideways. Public QR passport (/trace/SDC-2026-101) renders QR + full record on all viewports. Login regression passes (200 on /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me).

ui_bugs.issue: One 36x36 icon-only button on /monitor is below the 44px touch-target threshold (audited on mobile 390px). START/PAUSE/STOP and other critical controls meet 44px min-height as intended. This appears to be a small utility/close icon; confirm whether it should be enlarged for touch.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — comes from devtools/instrumentation wrapping option children in Traceability.jsx batch selector (line ~55). Cosmetic dev-only warning, not user-visible, but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: increase the 36x36 icon-only button on /monitor to 44x44 for consistent touch-target compliance.
Optional: fix the option/span hydration warning on /traceability by rendering plain text inside <option> without a wrapping <span>.
critical_code_review_comments: Route naming inconsistency risk: dashboard is served at '/' (not '/dashboard') and system status at '/status' (not '/system'). The review-request text uses '/dashboard' and '/system' — update either the routes or the documentation/tests to keep them aligned to avoid confusion.
New-batch route is '/new-batch' not '/batches/new' — same doc/code drift.
Traceability.jsx <option> children should not be wrapped in <span> (hydration warning).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive layout is solid across 1920/834/390 for all 8 auth routes + public /trace. Real routes are: /, /monitor, /new-batch, /history, /energy, /traceability, /status, /batches/:id. Batch History table intentionally scrolls inside its card. Mobile menu toggle testid: mobile-menu-toggle. Only minor items outstanding (see action_items).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions detected. Initial sweep briefly used doc-supplied paths ('/dashboard', '/system', '/batches/new') that don't exist as routes, causing blank <main>. Re-verified with the real routes from App.js and all content renders correctly.
